name: Sudakshya For Girls Child Scholarship
benefit:
1. Reimbursement of Admission and Hostel Fee.
   1. Maintenance Allowances will be given of ₹1,500/- per month for Hostellers and ₹500/- for Day Scholars.
   1. Reimbursable cost of uniform ₹3,000/-.
   1. Maintenance Allowances ₹1,000/- per month for Apprenticeship Training after ITI inside the state and ₹1,500/- per month for outside the state.
   1. One Month Maintenance Allowances of ₹5,000/-
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha state. 1. The applicant must be a girl child. 1. The applicant must belong to the General/ST/SC/OBC/SEBC/EBC category. 1. The applicant must be pursuing I.T.I. / I.T.C., Polytechnic/ Diploma courses.
